text:
sara: Quick follow-up from INC-2026 postmortem. We need a tight follow-up doc that lists: owners, deadlines, exact runbook diffs, and the PD ladder for the KV cache eviction recurrence. Dropping owners here so GH issue can link them.

ben: I can take runbook edits (triage checklist + commands). Will PR a one-page playbook with step-by-step checks and exact CLI snippets by Friday.

ari: I'll own monitoring/alerts. Proposal: composite alert (KV_EVICT_RATE > 0.4% OR KV_HIT_RATIO drop > 10% over 5m) with deploy-tag correlation. Will add dashboard and per-customer breakdown. ETA Tue.

maya: I'll do escalation & PD entries. Suggested ladder: oncall -> infra lead @15m -> SRE lead @30m -> region-fallback @45m. Also add a fast-canary rotate at 8m if initial mitigation fails.

sara: Good. Ben 5; please include a clear decision rule for 'force-evict now' vs 'wait for backoff', and a safe dry-run example. We had two noisy false positives last week so be explicit.

ben: Draft runbook snippet for the triage section (to include in PR):```bash
# list recent eviction events (10m)
rictl logs svc/inference --since 10m | jq 'select(.event=="kv_evict")' | tail -n 60
# check shard-level hit ratio
redwood-metrics query 'kv_cache_hit_ratio{shard="inference"}' --last 5m
# dry-run manual eviction for safety
rictl exec svc/inference --shard inference --force-kv-evict --dry-run
# apply manual eviction
rictl exec svc/inference --shard inference --force-kv-evict --confirm
# canary rotate sequence (one-liner)
opsctl rotate canary --service inference --shard inference --timeout 5m
```

ari: Nice. For alerts, include the link to the postmortem and the GH tracking issue in the alert body so responders have context. Also add an automated tag if a recent model-deploy exists (<30m).

maya: For PD messages, I'll add templated text and include quick links: playbook, postmortem, and the rollback snippet. Also will ask security to review notification content.

sara: One more: include a mitigation subsection for per-customer spikes (throttle key / proxy truncation) and a CS template to request temporary throttling while we investigate.

ben: Adding a customer-impact steps block with exact throttle command: `proxyctl throttle --api-key <key> --rate 5r/s` and a short CS template.

ops-bot: [ops-bot] Followup issue created: https://git.redwood/ops/inc-2026-remediations - owners: ben (runbook), ari (monitoring), maya (escalation).

sara: Timelines: ben PR by Fri, ari alerts by Tue, maya PD entries by Wed. I'll do a Monday check-in to confirm PR merged and playbook published. If any owner needs to shift timelines, post here so we can reassign. :thumbsup:
